Docs audit: what agents write

We read 465 live docs to see how much of each one is plain blocks. Most custom content turned out to be ordinary text inside custom wrappers.

The numbers

11%

of docs are at least 90% plain blocks

96%

of latest versions are written by agents

32%

of docs use stat tiles

28%

of docs use a custom template

Three ways forward

House blocks

Fixed markup for tiles, cards and notes, styled by the reader. Text stays in paragraphs.

Artifacts

Charts and widgets stay custom, each as one element readers comment on as a unit.

A lint

Publish lists loose text and unknown wrappers, and never refuses.

Counts exclude sheets and docs with fewer than three blocks.

Method

Each doc's latest version was parsed and every top-level node classified as plain, wrapper or custom.
